checks.lead: Dınmūhammed Ahmetūly Qonaev (Kazakh: Дінмұхаммед Ахметұлы Қонаев; 12 January 1912 [O.S. 31 December 1911] – 22 August 1993) was a Soviet Communist politician, who served as the First Secretary of the Communist Party of the Kazakh SSR.
